messages:
emma_fin: alert from the daily job: 12.6k USD spike associated with job job-1a2b — vendor invoice shows same image id across two regions. any quick theories?

raj_prod: that job runs in europe-west by default. we added a new prefetch sidecar last week that can overflow to a shared pool. could be spillover.

owen_infra: checking allocator logs now. found a spillover event at 2026-03-26T02:12Z where requests were routed to shared-pool in us-central1. log snippet: `2026-03-26T02:12:11Z decision=spillover pool=shared-pool reason=local_saturation job=job-1a2b`

ops-bot: billing-alert created BILL-247300 amount=12600 window=2026-03-26T02:00Z..2026-03-26T03:30Z.

emma_fin: vendor asked for instance->region mapping CSV within 4h. @owen_infra can you export and scrub?

owen_infra: yes, exporting now. will upload to /secure-shared/billing/correlations/job-1a2b-247300.csv and grant finance+ops access. sample rows: `instance_id,region,start_ts` `SP-7c1,us-central1,2026-03-26T02:12:12Z` `EU-9a3,europe-west1,2026-03-26T02:10:05Z`

emma_fin: finance note: if vendor denies credit we'll retrocharge infra. need confirmation from infra+product by EOD.

raj_prod: I'll open a PR to require explicit opt-in for spillover for high-cost jobs and to tag spillover instances with `origin=shared-pool`. PR refs will be posted here.

owen_infra: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/PR/912 (tagging + opt-out). uploading CSV now.

emma_fin: thanks — keeping pinned for ledger adjustments.
